column1: # Traditional Chinese (zh-hant) catalog for the whole CFA4 interface (Qt GUI and egui). Same format
# as es.tsv: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: made from CFA4's own clean-room Simplified Chinese catalog (zh-cn.tsv, same licence),
# converted to Traditional characters and Taiwan wording, then reviewed against the English labels with ordinary
# Traditional Chinese video-editing vocabulary (時間軸、軌道、剪輯、序列、素材箱、播放指示器、標記、
# 轉場、關鍵影格). No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI was consulted
# or copied; add entries the same way. Full-width punctuation and 「」 quotes; product and format
# names (CFA4, Lumetri, ProRes, AAF, EDL…) keep their spelling. A native-speaker review is welcome.
# Terms: clip = 剪輯, track = 軌道, sequence = 序列, timeline = 時間軸, bin = 素材箱, playhead =
# 播放指示器, marker = 標記, In/Out point = 入點/出點, keyframe = 關鍵影格, frame = 影格, caption =
# 字幕, preset = 預設集, workspace = 工作區, gain = 增益, opacity = 不透明度, render = 算圖, mask =
# 遮色片, template = 範本, (Legacy) = （舊版）.
# Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (CFA4 contributors), except the section imported from craft-i18n at
# the end (MIT OR Apache-2.0); see zh-hant.tsv.attribution.
